notes.title: 🔥 Spirit Mancer – Physical Release for PS5 and Switch 🔥
notes.content:
As Plug In Digital, we are very happy to announce a new collaboration with the Spanish publisher and distributor [b]Tesura Games[/b], alongside the talented developers at[b] Sunny Syrup Studio[/b]. Get ready to slash, shoot, and break demons in the exciting [b]new physical release of Spirit Mancer[/b]. This thrilling hack & slash deckbuilding game will launch in both Standard and Collector’s Editions for [b]PlayStation 5[/b] and [b]Nintendo Switch[/b] on[b] January 31, 2025[/b].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43051906/97b4486112e78c3e2e33156926a511761defff4d.jpg[/img]

[b]Spirit Mancer Collector’s Edition includes: [/b]
[list]
[*] Full Game Complete-in-Cart (NSW/PS5)
[*] Collector’s Box
[*] The Artbook of Spirit Mancer 154 pp.
[*] Comic Book +  100 pp.
[*] OST CD
[/list]
Feel the wrath of the Spirit Mancer and [b]pre-order it now[/b] at main retailers like the [b][url=https://store.tesuragames.com/productos/?_search=Spirit%20Mancer]Tesura Store[/url][/b] in Standard and Collector’s Edition!


🔥 [b]Join our community & see you soon in the Inferno![/b] 🔥

notes.title: Experience Spirit Mancer Anywhere with Steam Remote Play!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43051906/9d059c8b85b59473fc4cb26e8a37d5aeb5cd0afc.png[/img]

We’re happy to announce that [b]Spirit Mancer[/b] supports [b]Steam Remote Play[/b], bringing a whole new level of multiplayer fun to the game! You can now [b]team up with friends[/b] and dive into the Inferno together, no matter where you are.

[b]What is Steam Remote Play?[/b]  🕹️
Steam Remote Play allows you to stream Spirit Mancer to any device, meaning your friends can join your game even if they’re not on the same network. No more worrying about being in the same room or location, just connect and play!

[b]How Does It Work?[/b] 🕹️
[list]
[*] [b]Invite Friends[/b]: Easily send invites through Steam and have friends join your game, even if they don’t have the game installed.
[*] [b]Play Anywhere[/b]: Whether it’s on a PC or Steam Deck, everyone can join in on the adventure.
[/list]
This new feature makes it easier than ever to explore the world of Spirit Mancer with friends, no matter where they are. We hope you enjoy the new way to play and [b]stay tuned for more exciting updates[/b]!
